text:
Lina: Quick double-announcement — got promoted to Senior PM today and were also expecting a baby in October! Couldn't wait to share. :)
Omar: WHAT?? Double congrats!! :tada: :baby: Whens the due date? Coffee on me next week.
Diego: Senior PM + parenthood in one week. Legend. We need cake and balloons.
Maya: This calls for a mini poll — in-person treats? :cake: = cake, :doughnut: = donuts, :taco: = empanadas. React to vote.
HR-bot: Congrats Lina! Reminder: please submit a parental leave plan to People Ops within 30 days. Template: https://intranet/redwood/policies/parental-leave
Nora: Dibs to organize snacks and a tiny banner. Also happy to help prep any handover for the promotion. 4pm breakroom?
Lina: due date Oct 14. Cake wins so far (sorry empanadas). 4pm works great, thank you all!!
Omar: Adding confetti to the 4pm selfie. :confetti_ball:
Diego: If you want help ramping teammates into any responsibilities for the promotion/transition, Ill volunteer.
Maya: Also — suggestion: baby onesie with the Redwood tree? I can mock one up. :)
Lina: omg yes to the onesie. that would be adorable.
HR-bot: @Lina Congrats again! Parental leave summary: primary caregivers 16 weeks paid, secondary caregivers 8 weeks paid. Ping People Ops for forms and K/T adjustments.
Nora: Sending virtual hug now. :heartbeat: See you at 4 for cake + tiny celebration.
Lina: thank you, team. surreal day. see you at 4.
